```yaml
name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]

# Cancel outdated runs for efficiency
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Minimal permissions required for community tests
permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
  pull-requests: write

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: 1
  PYTHONUNBUFFERED: 1

jobs:
  code-quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          # Check if requirements are consistent with lockfile if present
          if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
            pip check
          fi

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure

      - name: Ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check .

      - name: Ruff format check
        run: |
          ruff format --check .

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            tests/unit/processing/ \
            tests/unit/graph/ \
            tests/unit/chunking/ \
            tests/unit/retrieval/ \
            tests/unit/search/ \
            tests/unit/pipelines/ \
            tests/unit/visualization/ \
            tests/unit/ontology/ \
            tests/unit/permissions/ \
            tests/unit/cache/ \
            tests/unit/session/ \
            tests/unit/config/ \
            tests/unit/eval/ \
            --ignore=tests/unit/api/ \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_rate_limiting_realistic.py \
            --ignore=tests/unit/test_embedding_rate_limiting_realistic.py \
            -v \
            --junitxml=results/unit-tests.xml

      - name: Publish Unit Test Results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: "results/unit-tests.xml"

  cli-tests:
    name: CLI Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run CLI Unit Tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            tests/unit/cli/ \
            -v \
            --junitxml=results/cli-tests.xml

      - name: Publish CLI Test Results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: "results/cli-tests.xml"

  telemetry-tests:
    name: Telemetry Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Run Telemetry Tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            tests/unit/telemetry/ \
            -v \
            --junitxml=results/telemetry-tests.xml

      - name: Publish Telemetry Test Results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: "results/telemetry-tests.xml"

  final-status:
    name: Final Status
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - code-quality
      - unit-tests
      - cli-tests
      - telemetry-tests
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check if all jobs succeeded
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.code-quality.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.unit-tests.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.cli-tests.result }}" != "success" ] || \
             [ "${{ needs.telemetry-tests.result }}" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::One or more test suites failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All community tests passed successfully."

      - name: Post consolidated notification
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          script: |
            const jobs = [
              { name: 'Code Quality', result: '${{ needs.code-quality.result }}' },
              { name: 'Unit Tests', result: '${{ needs.unit-tests.result }}' },
              { name: 'CLI Tests', result: '${{ needs.cli-tests.result }}' },
              { name: 'Telemetry Tests', result: '${{ needs.telemetry-tests.result }}' }
            ];
            
            let summary = '## Community Tests Summary\n\n';
            let allPassed = true;
            
            jobs.forEach(job => {
              const icon = job.result === 'success' ? '✅' : '❌';
              summary += `- ${icon} **${job.name}**: ${job.result}\n`;
              if (job.result !== 'success') allPassed = false;
            });
            
            if (allPassed) {
              summary += '\n🎉 All community tests passed!';
            } else {
              summary += '\n⚠️ Some tests failed. Please check the logs above.';
            }
            
            core.summary.addRaw(summary).write();
```
